title: Influence of the three-coordinate example
statement: For $t\in\mathbb{R}$, define $g_t:\{-1,1\}^3\to\mathbb{R}$ by $g_t(x)=\frac{t+1}{4}+\frac{t}{4}x_1+\frac{t}{4}x_2-\frac14x_0x_1+\frac14x_0x_2+\frac{t-1}{4}x_1x_2$. Its influence at coordinate $1$ is $\operatorname{Inf}_1(g_t)=\frac{t^2-t+1}{8}$.
